title: Job titles
description: Every job title of the group in one list with its code, grade, track and headcount. Click a title to open its card.
noMatches: No titles match the search or the filters
emptyHint: Titles are added from the units or imported from a file.

add.title: Add a job title
add.description: Choose the unit the title belongs to, then write its name, grade and track.

titles.title: Add job titles
titles.description: Add one or more job titles to the unit.
titles.templateHint: The title's role starts with this role's permissions; you then edit it from the roles page.
titles.none: This unit has no job titles yet.
titles.notAccepted: This type of unit takes no job titles and no employees. Titles belong to the units below it.
titles.deleteBody: A title that has employees cannot be deleted.
titles.noCodeYet: This title has no code: choose its grade and track to build it (once).
titles.reportsToHint: The higher title this one reports to. Search by name or code.

card.noCode: This title has no code yet: someone who may edit titles sets its grade and track, and the code is built.
card.stageText: {{stage}}: {{hours}} hours a year, budget cap {{budget}} SAR
card.stageNoRule: No rule covers this grade and track yet: HR decides.
card.stageNoGrade: The stage shows once the grade and track are set.
card.contentEmpty: No content has been entered for this title yet. It is imported from the titles file or written by someone who may edit title content.

chain.title: Who is the direct manager?
chain.rule: The manager is the nearest higher title that has a holder. Vacant titles are skipped, and the search never leaves the employee's company.
chain.label: Direct manager chain
chain.blocked: Outside the company: the search does not go beyond it
chain.foundCount: Direct manager: one of its holders ({{count}} holders)
chain.none: This employee has no manager in their company. They appear in the «units with no leader» report, and HR assigns one by hand with a date and a reason.
chain.noCompany: Choose a company that has holders of this title to see the manager chain.

content.title: Edit the title content
content.description: One item per line, in Arabic and English. Every save raises the content version.

import.codeHint: Leave empty for a new title: it is built from the unit, grade and track.
import.unitCodeHint: The unit a new title belongs to.
import.reportsToHint: The code of the higher title (in the file or already in the system).

reason.bad_code: The title code is not valid.
reason.unit_required: Give the unit code or the title code.
reason.unit_not_accepting: This unit does not take titles.
reason.unit_code_missing: The unit has no code yet.
reason.unit_mismatch: The title code does not match the unit code.
reason.grade_track_mismatch: The grade and track do not match the title code.
reason.grade_track_frozen: A title grade and track cannot change once its code is built.
reason.duplicate_in_file: The code appears twice in the file.
reason.sequence_taken: This sequence is already used in the same unit.
reason.reports_to_unknown: The title it reports to does not exist.
reason.reports_to_self: A title cannot report to itself.
reason.reports_to_cycle: The reporting line makes a loop.

job-titles.title: Job titles
job-titles.body: Every job title of the group in one list with its code, grade, track and headcount, with search and filters by sector, department, section, grade, track and vacancy, and import and export from a file.

can.create: Add a new title to a unit
can.update: Edit a title's name, grade, track and reporting line
can.content: Edit a title's responsibilities, qualifications and indicators
can.export: Export the titles to a file

title-card.title: The title card
title-card.body: Click any title to open its card: its code cut into parts, its grade, track and development stage, its content, who holds it in each company, and the direct-manager chain for an employee of a chosen company.
